params.body:
sign_urls (from #191) confirmed it: 222 of the 260 ms the twenty cards take is the AWS SDK presigning two URLs per card (11 ms each), and the first request after a deploy spent 21 s in it (cold SDK). A SigV4 query presign is four HMACs and two hashes.

- App\Support\S3Presigner: virtual-hosted style like the SDK, path style optional, X-Amz-Content-Sha256=UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD signed like the SDK does. No network.
- VehicleImageService::ondertekend() uses it when the vehicles disk is s3 with an endpoint and key; otherwise (local disk, tests with Storage::fake) the SDK path stays.
- Test: same host, path and signature as S3Client::createPresignedRequest for the same inputs (the SDK orders the query parameters differently; S3 sorts them itself), plus a path-style case.

Expected: view_cards from 260 ms to about 40 ms; the Stocklist render under 200 ms.
params.title: Own S3 presigner: 220 ms of SDK per page gone
